comments.content: The override of `FailCondition` changes the base behaviour. The base `ModSuddenDeath.FailCondition` likely checks `result.Type.AffectsCombo() && !result.IsHit` (or similar), but by overriding it here you may be dropping additional base logic (e.g. handling of `HitResult.Miss` vs `IgnoreMiss`, or the `healthProcessor` parameter). Please verify the base implementation and call `base.FailCondition(...)` where appropriate, or replicate all necessary checks. Also, `HitResult.IgnoreMiss` is typically used for slider tails that are not required for combo; failing on it when `SliderTailMiss` is enabled is the intent, but ensure this doesn't also trigger on other `IgnoreMiss` results (e.g. from spinners or other objects) — the `SliderTailCircle` type check handles that, but confirm `SliderTailCircle` is the correct type for all slider tail misses in this ruleset.
